== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タキール</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">戦闘で、双方のプレイヤーが運命数を1つずつ引いた時に使う。1フォース消費してその値を取り替えることができる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">タキールは落ち目のスニヴィアン傭兵であり 裏切り者としても知られる。スパイス中毒者で カンティーナで仕事をあさっている。犯罪者を帝国軍に売り渡すこともある。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Takeel]].

'''Lore''' — Takeel is a down-on-his-luck Snivvian mercenary, also known as a traitor. A spice addict, he hunts for work in the Cantina. He sometimes sells criminals to the Empire.

'''Game text''' — Use when both players have each drawn one destiny in battle. You may use 1 Force to switch those values.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore calls him down-on-his-luck and a traitor rather than burned-out and a double-crosser. Game text switches destinies drawn in battle, not battle destiny. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-takeel.gif|Original English face]], [[Takeel]].</ref>
